items.excerpt: At IBC 2026 Adobe debuted its Generative Media tool, which brings text-to-media AI generation directly into the Premiere Pro timeline, letting editors call Firefly and partner models like Veo, Kling, Runway and Luma without leaving the edit.
Strada 2.0 and Strada Connect stitch distributed media libraries together and route AI workflows across globally scattered post teams, a peer-to-peer answer to where footage and models actually live.

James Cameron's Lightstorm Vision has acquired Outsyders, whose AI-driven stereoscopic conversion pipeline delivered 3D versions of Lilo & Stitch and IMAX's Blue Angels, folding machine-assisted 2D-to-3D into an in-house production stack.
A post-production reporter's walkthrough of IBC 2026, weighing the AI features Adobe, Blackmagic and others shipped against what editors and colorists will actually adopt.
Colorfront brought an automated timeline comparison engine and Dolby Vision 2 mastering to IBC, automating the version-checking drudgery that eats mastering hours.
At IBC, Blackmagic drew a deliberate line: DaVinci Resolve's AI stays an assistant that organizes media and drives batch renders, not a generator that makes creative decisions for the editor.
A show-floor video walkthrough of Adobe's IBC2026 Premiere stand, covering the new AI object masking and generative media features editors will meet in the next release.
Adobe explains Premiere's new AI tools in its own words — what the Object Mask model actually does to tracking and masking, and where the company drew the line on generation.
Adobe's Photoshop Elements and Premiere Elements 2027 push AI-powered editing down to the consumer tier, a useful read on which pro features get commoditized first.
You don't have to use AI in your film — but proving you didn't is becoming its own production task, as provenance metadata and C2PA-style credentials move into the filmmaking workflow.

Pitch Black is rolling REVIZE, Rising Sun's face- and body-replacement machine learning toolset, across all of its global studios — a sign ML replacement work is becoming standard pipeline rather than a one-off.
'About a Hero,' a partly AI-generated docu-mystery narrated by a synthetic Werner Herzog voice, debuts its trailer — a test case for what a machine-authored documentary voice actually sounds like.
Open Art CEO Coco Mao argues generative tools won't replace live film production yet, mapping where AI genuinely speeds a shoot and where physical production still wins.

A full-length AI-generated Odyssey lands in front of critics, and the review is a concrete inventory of where generative video still breaks down across 2.5 hours of continuity, performance and pacing.
Executives from Alibaba, Sonilo and PROMPTR debate AI filmmaking at Venice's Production Bridge, including an AI-directed series whose scoring time dropped from ten hours to twenty seconds.
